authority: P4-N2; D-20260905-P4-001 (user option C); docs/02_METHOD_SPEC_AMR.md M1
frozen_before: any AMR M1 training or result inspection
evidence_scope: train/valid dev only; NO reserved (J03WQQ) or external (SoccerTrack) reads; those need explicit user re-authorization (P4-N5/N6)

model.encoder: GraphEncoder (frozen width, same backbone as T5R TaskModel family)
model.band_windows: 6 equal-width cosine-tapered windows on normalized-Laplacian spectrum [0,2]
model.context_channel: raw view -> team_mean pool -> pool_projection -> phase/zone/centroid heads
model.mode_channel: centered view -> per-band P_b(L)H -> team_mean pool -> band projection -> mode_head

routing_assignment.rule: fixed per-band gates for the intrinsic/mode channel; set from config, never learned (M1)
evidence_basis: v3 (D-20260905-P4-004): ALL bands recoverable. Band-0 invariance removed: translation invariance is already guaranteed by construction (centered view, T5R3/T5R5 z_mode response ~0); a learned invariance objective on top is redundant and empirically destructive on a shared trunk (v1 mode-channel collapse; v2 seed-11 total trunk collapse incl. context channel).
bands 1-5 recoverable (unchanged): P2 honest negative (20/36 vs 16/36) forbids presetting any mid band as repair target.

support factor: support-conditioned whitened sampling retained; KNOWN DESIGN RISK (graph uncertainty): node-domain support masking and spectral band-limiting are only approximately compatible; per-(band, support-size) diagnostics recorded.

losses.L_task: pair triplet margin loss on z_mode (same PAIR_MARGIN as frozen recipe)
losses.L_ctx: phase CE + zone CE + centroid MSE on z_ctx (same as frozen context_loss)
losses.L_route: sum_b alpha_b ||Dr_b||^2 + (1-alpha_b) ||W_b Dr_b - pool(P_b(L)delta)||^2; W_b restricted linear 32->4
losses.weights_rationale: task/context losses dominant and equal to frozen recipe; route at parity as the new mechanism signal; regularizers one/two orders below

training_protocol.budget_rationale: total equals the frozen T5R4 recipe (420/epoch) for equal-compute comparability; context/intrinsic streams identical in distribution to the frozen recipe
training_protocol.route_sampling: per route update: uniform band b; same-team support size uniform in {2,3,4,5}; xi masked to support; delta = 0.25 * P_b(L) xi_S / ||.||_F applied to centered coordinates
training_protocol.data: IDSSE dev stand-in, train split only; split_lock unchanged
training_protocol.streams: context seed*100000, pair seed*200000, route seed*300000 (disjoint from frozen streams)

evaluation_plan.task_metrics: frozen valid metrics (zone/pair/geometry-proxy/centroid/translation/cross-readout), same functions as T5R
evaluation_plan.intervention_metrics: frozen operator t5r5_support_reallocation_v1 eps=0.25 support=4 draw=0 on dev snapshots; full/diag/offdiag + spectral baseline, same functions as P3 intervention evals
evaluation_plan.mechanism_diagnostics: per-(band, support-size) response profile; JVP vs central finite-difference parity on mode channel (spec 4.3)
evaluation_plan.success_criteria_descriptive: H1: robustness-structure Pareto improvement vs matched-capacity controls (P4-N4); H2: invariance gain concentrated in band 0, coupling bands retain recoverability. Any systematic reversal -> contract claim and stop (no M2)

controls_for_N4: relational pooling (T5R3 relational variant, frozen numbers)

addenda.change: AMRModel gains eqv_heads (per-band restricted linear 32->4, spec 7.2) and a frozen-eval-compatible encode() returning flattened band features + mode_embedding accepting flat or band-shaped input; no protocol content changed
addenda.reason: make the frozen T5R5/epsilon-sweep evaluation machinery reusable verbatim; recoverability heads are part of the model definition

addenda.trigger: v1 dev collapse (reports/P4_N3_V1_COLLAPSE_REPORT.md): mode channel near-total collapse 3/3 seeds
changes: L_eqv normalized direction recovery: compare L2-normalized prediction with L2-normalized pooled band target (collapse makes normalized readout unstable -> equivariance bands penalize collapse)
W_var 0.1 -> 1.0 (variance floor at parity with route pressure)
addenda.justification: spec 7.2 recoverability tests information accessibility; magnitude-free directional readout is the stricter test; collapse must be costly for the 5 recoverable bands

single-variable change isolating invariance pressure as the destructive factor; recoverability everywhere is the most conservative routing consistent with the P2 honest negative; collapse is costly for all bands under normalized readout
